displayTitle: Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie
synopsis: In a sequel to "The Star Wars Storybook" and "The Empire Strikes Back Storybook", Luke Skywalker and his friends in the Rebel Alliance formulate a daring plan to battle with the Empire and its evil leaders, Darth Vader and the Emperor.
title: Return of the Jedi: The Storybook Based on the Movie
